options.name: Wrong tool
options.definition: An unsuitable tool is selected or used for the operation. The correct replacement requires separate evidence.

options.name: Procedural
options.definition: An error concerning procedure requirements. A specific omitted, extra or misordered step requires separate evidence.

hands.description: The left hand holds and stabilizes a small metallic cylindrical component on the table, adjusting its position slightly while the right hand works on it.
The right hand manipulates a part on the metallic component held by the left hand, using fingers to adjust or insert a small element.

visual_review.factual_description: The right hand uses fingers to turn and loosen a small screw on the metallic gearbox housing held by the left hand, then continues holding the housing and drive shaft assembly.
